abstract: The ‘Broadband China’ policy, a series of digital infrastructure modernization projects starting in 2014, greatly expanded and improved local Internet access. This study utilizes the 2011–2016 firm-level data in a staggered difference-in-differences model to examine the energy efficiency gain from the policy. The findings show that the policy-covered enterprises reduced their energy intensity by 2.34% more than their uncovered counterparts, comprising 11.2% of the total Five-Year-Plan target in the sample period. This effect was more pronounced among firms in manufacturing, in eastern and central regions, in non-resource-based cities and among non-state-owned or large-scale firms. Mechanism analysis indicates that the policy reduces energy consumption and emissions by enhancing managerial efficiency and stimulating green innovation. This study shows that digital infrastructure promotes firms’ low-carbon transitions and also advances corporate social responsibility and sustainable development.
abstract_zh: 宽带中国”政策是自2014年起实施的一系列数字基础设施现代化项目，显著扩大并改善了地方互联网接入。本研究利用2011-2016年企业层面数据，采用交错双重差分模型，考察该政策带来的能效提升效应。研究发现，受政策覆盖的企业能源强度比未覆盖企业多降低2.34%，占样本期内整个五年计划目标的11.2%。这一效应在制造业企业、东部和中部地区、非资源型城市以及非国有或大型企业中更为显著。机制分析表明，该政策通过提升管理效率和激发绿色创新来降低能源消耗与排放。本研究显示，数字基础设施不仅推动企业低碳转型，还促进了企业社会责任与可持续发展。

title: Digital superhighways to sustainability: the impact of large-scale digital infrastructure construction on firms’ energy efficiency

abstract: Under policy incentives, the digital transformation of the traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) industry has emerged as a critical pathway for overcoming structural upgrading bottlenecks and fostering end-to-end collaborative development. Drawing on panel data from 75 listed TCM manufacturing firms in China from 2015 to 2023, this study examines the impact of digital investment on supply chain resilience in TCM leading firms and explores the mediating role of dual-chain coupling between the capital chain and talent chain. Fixed-effects models, Sobel-Goodman mediation tests, and instrumental variable (2SLS) estimation are employed to test the proposed relationships. The results reveal that digital investment significantly enhances supply chain resilience, and that dual-chain coupling serves as the core transmission mechanism, accounting for over 90% of the total effect. These results offer theoretical insights and practical guidance for TCM enterprises seeking to optimize digital strategies, strengthen supply chain resilience, and achieve sustainable and innovation-driven growth.
abstract_zh: 在政策激励下，中医药行业数字化转型已成为突破结构性升级瓶颈、推动全链条协同发展的关键路径。本研究基于2015-2023年中国75家上市中医药制造企业面板数据，考察数字投资对中医药龙头企业供应链韧性的影响，并探究资金链与人才链双链耦合的中介作用。采用固定效应模型、Sobel-Goodman中介效应检验及工具变量两阶段最小二乘法（2SLS）对假设关系进行验证。结果表明：数字投资显著提升供应链韧性，且双链耦合构成核心传导机制，其解释力占总效应的90%以上。该研究为中医药企业优化数字战略、强化供应链韧性及实现可持续创新增长提供了理论启示与实践指导。

abstract: Abstract Dispute resolution in low-income countries is typically done by either a costly and slow formal court or an informal institution without state-sanctioned enforcement powers. Can access to justice be increased by combining the best aspects of formal and informal institutions? We evaluate the effects of “Village Courts” (VCs) in rural Bangladesh using a large-scale field experiment. The introduction of VCs more than doubles the share of disputes resolved in state-sanctioned courts, but an informal institution called shalish remains dominant. There is some substitution from shalish to VCs, but congestion in higher-level courts, village social dynamics, and economic activity remain unaffected.
abstract_zh: 低收入国家的纠纷解决通常依赖于成本高昂且效率低下的正式法院，或缺乏国家强制执行力保障的非正式机构。能否通过融合正式与非正式机构的优势来提升司法可及性？我们通过一项大规模实地实验，评估了孟加拉国农村地区"村级法院"（VCs）的实施效果。村级法院的引入使经国家认可法院解决的纠纷比例提升了一倍以上，但名为"沙利什"的非正式机构仍占据主导地位。尽管存在从沙利什向村级法院的部分替代效应，但上级法院的案件积压、村庄社会动态及经济活动均未受到显著影响。
title: Formalizing Dispute Resolution: Effects of Village Courts in Bangladesh
title_zh: 正式化争端解决：孟加拉国村级法庭的影响

abstract: Abstract We explore the mechanics of empathy. We show that information about an outgroup can activate and magnify empathy when presented in conjunction with an experience simulating their struggles. This response increases the willingness to help the struggling group. We provide evidence for this effect in an immersive virtual reality experiment where participants (“witnesses”) experience a simulation of the struggle of unauthorized migrants (“protagonists”), then replicate these results in a series of controlled lab experiments. We show that information enhances the witnesses’ empathetic response and drives them to engage in more prosocial behavior when it increases their perceived interpersonal similarity, or relatability to the protagonist — an effect we trace to attention: eye-tracking data reveals that information provision concentrates witnesses’ gaze on the struggles of the protagonist instead of searching through peripheral elements of the scene. Conversely, only information packages that strengthen perceived relatability — an effect that can vary across subgroups with heterogeneous attributes — magnify empathy. Together, our evidence suggests that the ability to put oneself in the shoes of another person or group can be enhanced by activating empathy through simple, targeted, information provision.
abstract_zh: 摘要 我们探讨了共情的运作机制。研究表明，当关于外群体的信息与模拟其困境的体验相结合时，能够激活并放大共情反应。这种反应会增强帮助困境群体的意愿。我们通过沉浸式虚拟现实实验为这一效应提供了证据——参与者（"见证者"）体验了未经授权移民（"主角"）的困境模拟，随后在一系列受控实验室实验中复现了这些结果。我们发现，当信息能够提升见证者感知到的人际相似性或与主角的关联性时，会增强其共情反应并促使更多亲社会行为——我们将这一效应归因于注意力机制：眼动追踪数据显示，信息提供使见证者的凝视焦点集中于主角的困境，而非搜索场景中的外围元素。反之，只有那些能强化感知关联性的信息组合（该效应可能因亚群体异质性特征而存在差异）才能放大共情。综合证据表明，通过简单、定向的信息提供激活共情，可以增强个体设身处地理解他人或群体处境的能力。
title: In their Shoes: Empathy Through Information
title_zh: 感同身受：信息中的共情

abstract: ABSTRACT This paper examines the influence of gender on the adoption of Climate‐Smart Agriculture (CSA) practices in West Africa. An exogenous switching treatment effect regression model with the Oaxaca–Blinder decomposition method is used in the study. Data were collected from the 2018/2019 Harmonized Household Living Conditions Survey across five West African countries. The results indicate that if female plot managers had the same characteristics as their male counterparts, their likelihood of adopting CSA practices would increase, yet it would still be lower than that of men. The decomposition analysis shows a significant gender gap favouring men in Burkina Faso and Senegal, unlike in Ivory Coast and Togo. These gender differences are mainly due to structural factors such as household size, education, access to credit, commercialisation, income, livestock ownership, family labour, pesticide use, soil fertility and the availability of agricultural extension agents and cooperatives. To effectively address gender disparities in CSA adoption, policies could focus on improving these structural conditions rather than solely on ensuring equal access to production resources. This approach would enhance policy effectiveness and empower women to better utilise their agricultural resources.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了性别对西非气候智慧型农业（CSA）实践采纳的影响。研究采用外生转换处理效应回归模型与奥克萨卡-布林德分解方法，数据来源于2018/2019年五个西非国家的统一家庭生活条件调查。结果表明，若女性地块管理者具备与男性相同的特征，其采纳CSA实践的可能性将有所提升，但仍低于男性。分解分析显示，布基纳法索和塞内加尔存在显著偏向男性的性别差距，而科特迪瓦和多哥则未出现此类差异。这些性别差异主要源于结构性因素，包括家庭规模、教育水平、信贷获取、商业化程度、收入、牲畜所有权、家庭劳动力、农药使用、土壤肥力以及农业推广人员和合作社的可及性。为有效解决CSA采纳中的性别差异，政策应侧重于改善这些结构性条件，而非仅关注生产资源的平等获取。这一方法将提升政策有效性，并增强女性利用农业资源的能力。

abstract: Abstract We study privatization and corporate ownership in transportation infrastructure, focusing on global airports. Privatization in general does not improve performance. However, private equity (PE) ownership has strong and persistent positive effects on efficiency, volume, and quality, with positive externalities for the local economy. We address selection using close auctions where PE and non-PE firms bid. PE funds expand physical capacity and encourage larger planes while adding low-cost carriers and international routes. They are especially effective in countries with more corruption or state-owned flag carriers. In contrast, the poorer performance of non-PE acquirers may reflect private benefits and historical state ties.
abstract_zh: 摘要 本文研究交通基础设施领域的私有化与企业所有权问题，重点关注全球机场。总体而言，私有化并未显著提升绩效。然而，私募股权（PE）所有权对效率、运力及服务质量具有持续且强劲的积极影响，并对当地经济产生正向外部效应。我们利用私募股权与非私募股权企业竞标的封闭式拍卖机制解决选择偏差问题。私募股权基金通过扩大物理容量、鼓励使用大型飞机，同时引入低成本航空公司及国际航线来提升运营表现。在腐败程度较高或存在国有旗舰航空公司的国家，私募股权的效果尤为显著。相比之下，非私募股权收购方的较差表现可能反映了其私人收益动机及历史性国有关联。
title: All Clear for Takeoff: Evidence from Airports on the Effects of Infrastructure Privatization
title_zh: 基础设施私有化效应的机场证据：一切就绪，准备起飞

abstract: Abstract A central question in economics is how talent is allocated across elite professions and whether access is shaped by family ties or by open, standardized systems of selection. We study these questions in Western classical composition, a setting in which family background historically influenced entry through both inherited skill and inherited privilege, and where rich biographical records make it possible to trace selection over multiple centuries. Using data on more than 16,000 composers from 450 CE to the present, we identify dynastic ties from Grove Music Online and measure prominence by biographical entry length. Dynastic composers are 15–21 percent less prominent than non-dynasts, conditional on country and birth cohort, and this discount is driven by descendants: founders perform about as well as non-dynasts, while descendants perform significantly worse. Archival manuscript evidence from the Répertoire International des Sources Musicales yields similar results, suggesting that the pattern is not an artifact of editorial selection. In the twentieth century, however, the dynasty discount reverses, consistent with the transition from informal, family-based entry to more standardized selection through conservatory training. Consistent with this interpretation, dynasts are less likely to have formal training mentioned in their biographies, more likely to be described as advancing through family connections, and face a smaller dynasty discount in regions and periods with conservatories. Taken together, the findings suggest that expanded access to standardized training can weaken inherited advantage, reshape elite formation, and improve talent allocation, with broader implications for long-run innovation and economic performance.
abstract_zh: 经济学的一个核心问题是，人才如何在精英职业中分配，以及进入这些职业的途径是由家庭关系塑造，还是由开放、标准化的选拔体系决定。我们以西方古典作曲为背景研究这些问题，在这一领域中，家庭背景历史上通过继承技能和继承特权影响进入，而丰富的传记记录使我们能够追溯多个世纪的选拔过程。利用公元450年至今超过16,000名作曲家的数据，我们从《格罗夫音乐在线》中识别出家族纽带，并通过传记条目长度衡量知名度。在控制国家和出生队列的条件下，家族作曲家的知名度比非家族作曲家低15%至21%，这一折扣主要由后代驱动：创始人的表现与非家族作曲家相当，而后代的表现则显著较差。来自《国际音乐源目录》的档案手稿证据得出了类似结果，表明这一模式并非编辑选择的产物。然而，在20世纪，家族折扣发生了逆转，这与从非正式、基于家庭的进入向通过音乐学院培训进行标准化选拔的转变相一致。与这一解释一致的是，家族作曲家在其传记中提及正式培训的可能性较低，更可能被描述为通过家庭关系晋升，并且在有音乐学院的地区和时期，家族折扣较小。综合来看，这些发现表明，扩大标准化培训的获取渠道可以削弱继承优势，重塑精英形成，并改善人才分配，对长期创新和经济表现具有更广泛的意义。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: What’s in a name? Dynasties, selection, and talent allocation among classical composers
title_zh: 名字里有什么？古典作曲家中的家族传承、选拔与人才配置

abstract: Many communities in the U.S. have programs that make financial assistance available to families with low incomes who are struggling to pay rent. In this paper, we examine the average and distributional impacts of reducing wait times for emergency housing assistance on evictions. Taking advantage of administrative data from Franklin County, Ohio and exploiting exogenous changes in application processing times in two complementary empirical approaches, we find that each additional week of delay in receiving assistance increases the probability of an eviction filing within 12 months by 19–29%. A substantial share of the additional filings result in judgments against tenants. Our results have important implications for the design and implementation of emergency rental assistance programs. More broadly, our findings speak to the downstream impacts of passive compliance costs in social safety net programs.
abstract_zh: 美国许多社区设有项目，为难以支付租金的低收入家庭提供经济援助。本文研究了缩短紧急住房援助等待时间对驱逐事件的平均影响及分布效应。利用俄亥俄州富兰克林县的行政数据，并借助两种互补实证方法中申请处理时间的外生变化，我们发现：援助每延迟一周，12个月内收到驱逐申请的概率将增加19%至29%。这些额外申请中有相当比例最终导致对租户不利的判决。我们的研究结果对紧急租金援助项目的设计与实施具有重要启示。更广泛而言，本研究揭示了社会安全网项目中被动合规成本的后续影响。
title: Can rapid rental assistance avert evictions? Evidence from administrative delays
title_zh: 快速租金援助能否避免驱逐？来自行政延迟的证据

title: Reaching for influence: Do banks use loans to establish political connections?
title_zh: 寻求影响力：银行是否利用贷款建立政治关联？

title_zh: 跨国网络重构、地缘政治暴露与母国效应——基于欧洲跨国企业的证据

abstract: Abstract This paper studies the impact of income-based criminal punishments on crime. In Finland, speeding tickets become income-dependent if the driver’s speed exceeds the speeding limit by more than 20 km/h, leading to a substantial jump in the size of the speeding ticket. Contrary to predictions of a traditional Becker model, individuals do not bunch below the fine hike. Instead, the speeding distributions are smooth at the cutoff. However, I demonstrate that the size of the realized speeding ticket has sizable, but short-lived, impacts on reoffending. I use a regression discontinuity design to show that fines that are, on average, 200 euros larger decrease reoffending by 15 percent in the following six months. The drop in reoffending is driven by high-income individuals facing the highest fine at the cutoff. I estimate that a fixed fine hike that matches the current deterrence effect would raise the fine increase faced by the bottom income quartile by about 300% at the cutoff, relative to the increase they face under the current income-based schedule. My empirical results are consistent with an explanation that people operate under information frictions. To illustrate this, I construct a Becker model with misperception and learning that can explain all the empirical findings.
abstract_zh: 摘要  本文研究了基于收入的刑事罚款对犯罪的影响。在芬兰，当驾驶员超速超过限速20公里/小时以上时，罚款金额与收入挂钩，导致罚款数额大幅跃升。与传统贝克尔模型的预测相反，个体并未在罚款激增点附近聚集，而是超速分布在临界点处保持平滑。然而，本文证明实际罚款金额对再犯行为具有显著但短暂的影响。通过断点回归设计，本文发现平均高出200欧元的罚款可使随后六个月的再犯率降低15%。再犯率的下降主要由临界点处面临最高罚款的高收入群体驱动。本文估算，若采用固定罚款增幅以达到当前威慑效果，则临界点处最低收入四分位群体面临的罚款增幅将比现行收入挂钩机制下的增幅提高约300%。实证结果与个体存在信息摩擦的解释一致。为阐明这一点，本文构建了一个包含认知偏差与学习机制的贝克尔模型，该模型能够解释所有实证发现。
title: How Do People React to Income-Based Fines? Evidence from Speeding Tickets Discontinuities
title_zh: 人们如何应对基于收入的罚款？来自超速罚单断点回归的证据

abstract: ABSTRACT Demand estimates are commonly used to inform firm strategy and public policy, yet they can obscure important variation in demand across geographic space that is relevant for local business decisions and policy interventions. Prior work documents demand heterogeneity across countries, regions, states, and between coarse urban‐rural categories, but evidence on sub‐metropolitan variation is limited. This study documents within‐metro geographic heterogeneity in market shares and willingness‐to‐pay (WTP) for retail and foodservice protein products. I use nearly six years of publicly available survey data and random parameters logit models that include municipality interactions with alternative‐specific constants and price sensitivity to estimate municipality‐specific market shares and WTP in the Phoenix metropolitan area. Demand varies substantially across adjacent municipalities. Central Phoenix residents exhibit higher retail WTP for conventional beef, pork, and chicken products, while both central Phoenix and Scottsdale‐Tempe residents show consistently higher foodservice WTP. Median WTP in these municipalities is roughly 30–50% higher than in surrounding suburbs, whereas suburban groups exhibit similar valuations to one another. These within‐metro differences are large enough to affect targeted pricing and assortment strategies and to produce uneven distributional welfare effects from local price policies (e.g., taxes). The results suggest that investment in geographically refined demand analyses could better inform policy interventions and business decisions at the local level, where those decisions are often made.
abstract_zh: 摘要 需求估计常用于指导企业战略和公共政策，但可能掩盖地理空间上需求的重要差异，而这些差异与地方商业决策和政策干预密切相关。已有研究记录了国家、地区、州以及城乡粗分类之间的需求异质性，但关于大都市内部次区域差异的证据仍然有限。本研究揭示了凤凰城大都市区内零售和餐饮服务蛋白质产品市场份额及支付意愿（WTP）的地理异质性。利用近六年的公开调查数据，通过随机参数Logit模型（包含市政区与替代特定常数及价格敏感性的交互项），估算了凤凰城大都市区各市政区的市场份额和支付意愿。相邻市政区之间的需求存在显著差异。凤凰城市中心居民对传统牛肉、猪肉和鸡肉产品的零售支付意愿更高，而凤凰城市中心及斯科茨代尔-坦佩居民的餐饮服务支付意愿始终较高。这些市政区的支付意愿中位数比周边郊区高出约30-50%，而郊区群体之间的估值则较为接近。这种大都市内部差异足以影响针对性的定价和品类策略，并导致地方价格政策（如税收）产生不均衡的福利分配效应。研究结果表明，投资于地理精细化需求分析，能够更好地为地方层面的政策干预和商业决策提供信息，而这类决策通常正是在地方层面做出的。
title: Beyond Metropolitan Averages: Food Demand Across Local Markets
title_zh: 超越都市均值：地方市场的食品需求

title: Agricultural workers’ employment cycles and churn in the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program: A descriptive analysis
title_zh: 农业工人就业周期与补充营养援助计划中的流失：一项描述性分析

abstract: Institutional opening has emerged as a significant policy instrument for shaping long-term investment decisions, particularly when the marginal effects of factor-based opening become less pronounced and foreign investment becomes increasingly sensitive to the institutional environment and policy expectations. This paper treats the establishment of a pilot free trade zone (FTZ) in a region with relatively weak institutional foundations as a quasi-natural experiment. Using provincial panel data from 2008 to 2022, this study applies the synthetic control method and the synthetic difference-in-differences method to test the impact of FTZ policies on the total investment of foreign-invested enterprises. The results show that FTZ policies significantly increased the total investment of foreign-invested enterprises in the treated province, with an average policy effect of approximately 34.4%. Further analysis indicates that this effect is primarily reflected in the growth in medium- and long-term investment arrangements rather than increases in current capital inflows alone. This finding suggests that institutional opening can promote foreign investment by enhancing investors’ expectations regarding institutional stability and policy predictability. Comparisons across regions also indicate that the effect is stronger in regions with relatively weak institutional foundations, whereas the marginal effect is smaller in regions with more developed institutional conditions.
abstract_zh: 制度型开放已成为塑造长期投资决策的重要政策工具，尤其是在要素型开放的边际效应逐渐减弱、外资对制度环境与政策预期日益敏感的背景下。本文将自由贸易试验区在制度基础相对薄弱地区的设立视为准自然实验，利用2008—2022年省级面板数据，采用合成控制法和合成双重差分法检验自贸区政策对外商投资企业投资总额的影响。结果表明，自贸区政策显著提升了处理省份外商投资企业的投资总额，平均政策效应约为34.4%。进一步分析显示，这一效应主要体现在中长期投资安排的增长，而非当期资本流入的增加。这一发现表明，制度型开放能够通过增强投资者对制度稳定性和政策可预期性的预期来促进外商投资。跨区域比较也显示，在制度基础相对薄弱的地区，该效应更为显著，而在制度条件较为完善的地区，边际效应较小。

title: Institutional opening and foreign investment commitment: evidence from China’s Free Trade Zones
title_zh: 制度型开放与外商投资承诺：来自中国自贸区的证据

abstract: This study addresses the research gap regarding how government-led industrial policies catalyse micro-level technological transformation in emerging markets. Drawing on the resource-based view and the knowledge-based view, we empirically investigate the impact of intelligent manufacturing projects on corporate artificial intelligence innovation applications. Using a comprehensive sample of A-share listed companies in China from 2010 to 2023, we employ a staggered difference-in-differences framework and a double machine learning approach to ensure methodological robustness and mitigate high-dimensional selection bias. The findings reveal that the implementation of intelligent manufacturing projects significantly enhances artificial intelligence innovation levels within firms, with a 28.85% improvement compared with the average level. Mechanism analysis indicates that this promoting effect operates through the enhancement of data element utilization, the facilitation of cross-domain knowledge integration, and the expansion of research and development investment. Heterogeneity analysis further shows that the impact is more pronounced in non-state-owned enterprises, firms with higher degrees of digital transformation, and those in high-tech industries. This research clarifies the causal pathways of policy-driven innovation and offers practical guidance for the precise promotion of intelligent manufacturing initiatives and the efficient implementation of corporate transformation.
abstract_zh: 本研究聚焦于政府主导的产业政策如何在新兴市场中催化微观层面技术变革这一研究空白。基于资源基础观与知识基础观，我们实证考察了智能制造项目对企业人工智能创新应用的影响。利用2010至2023年中国A股上市公司综合样本，采用交错双重差分框架与双机器学习方法，以确保方法稳健性并缓解高维选择偏差。研究发现，智能制造项目的实施显著提升了企业人工智能创新水平，相较于平均水平改善幅度达28.85%。机制分析表明，这一促进效应通过提升数据要素利用率、促进跨领域知识整合以及扩大研发投入三条路径实现。异质性分析进一步显示，该影响在非国有企业、数字化转型程度较高的企业以及高技术产业中更为显著。本研究厘清了政策驱动创新的因果路径，为精准推进智能制造举措及高效实施企业转型提供了实践指导。

title: Driving corporate artificial intelligence applications: evidence from intelligent manufacturing projects
title_zh: 驱动企业人工智能应用：来自智能制造项目的证据

abstract: This study examines the moderating effect of the minimum wage on the relationship between industrial robots and labour mobility in China. Using provincial-industrial panel data from 2006–2019, combining China’s industrial database and IFR robot data, we analyse patterns of labour mobility at both regional and industry levels. To ensure the robustness of the results, we discuss potential collinearity between robot penetration and the minimum wage, as well as the persistence of the relation of the baseline results. Our findings reveal that the minimum wage negatively moderates the positive effect of robots on regional labour mobility while amplifying their impact on inter-industry labour reallocation. Heterogeneity analysis shows these effects are stronger in regions with lower education levels and higher employment rates. Although the minimum wage exhibits no significant lagged effects on regional labour mobility, it demonstrates persistent effects on industrial labour mobility. Long-term analysis further indicates that the minimum wage amplifies robots’ negative influence on regional labour flows while enhancing industrial labour reallocation. These findings suggest the need for coordinated policies that consider both automation trends and regional labour market characteristics when setting the minimum wage.
abstract_zh: 本研究考察了最低工资对中国工业机器人影响劳动力流动的调节效应。基于2006-2019年省级-行业面板数据，结合中国工业数据库与国际机器人联合会（IFR）机器人数据，我们从区域和行业两个层面分析了劳动力流动模式。为确保结果稳健性，我们探讨了机器人渗透率与最低工资之间可能存在的多重共线性问题，以及基准结果关系的持续性。研究发现：最低工资对机器人促进区域劳动力流动的正向效应具有负向调节作用，同时强化了机器人对跨行业劳动力再配置的影响。异质性分析表明，在受教育水平较低、就业率较高的地区，上述调节效应更为显著。尽管最低工资对区域劳动力流动未呈现显著滞后效应，但其对行业间劳动力流动具有持续影响。长期分析进一步显示，最低工资会放大机器人对区域劳动力流动的抑制作用，同时增强行业间劳动力再配置效应。这些发现表明，在制定最低工资标准时，需要统筹考虑自动化发展趋势与区域劳动力市场特征，实施协调性政策。

title: Beyond substitution: the moderating effect of the minimum wage on robot-labour dynamics in China
title_zh: 超越替代：最低工资对中国机器人-劳动力动态关系的调节效应

abstract: Promoting green innovation agglomeration (GIA) is essential for achieving a sustainable industrial transformation, strengthening resource efficiency and advancing the low-carbon progression. However, the role of eco-industrial demonstration parks (EIDPs) in fostering GIA remains insufficiently explored. Using panel data from 297 prefecture-level cities in China for the period 2000–2022, this study systematically examines the impact of EIDPs on GIA. The empirical results show that (1) EIDPs significantly promote GIA, a conclusion that maintains its validity through robustness and endogeneity checks. (2) Heterogeneity checks indicate that the EIDPs’ effect is more evident among cities possessing high government governance capacity, high environmental preference, and high market spillover level. (3) A mechanism analysis reveals that EIDPs enhance GIA by improving green technology diversity, innovation factors’ allocation efficiency and external media coverage. Such outcomes enrich research on EIDPs and GIA and provide policy insights for optimizing EIDPs’ governance, improving green innovation resource allocation, and accelerating the formation of regionally coordinated green innovation systems.
abstract_zh: 促进绿色创新集聚是实现可持续产业转型、增强资源效率以及推动低碳进程的关键。然而，生态工业示范园区在培育绿色创新集聚方面的作用尚未得到充分探讨。本研究利用2000—2022年中国297个地级市的面板数据，系统考察了生态工业示范园区对绿色创新集聚的影响。实证结果表明：（1）生态工业示范园区显著促进了绿色创新集聚，该结论在稳健性检验和内生性检验中依然成立；（2）异质性检验显示，生态工业示范园区的效应在政府治理能力高、环境偏好强以及市场溢出水平高的城市中更为显著；（3）机制分析揭示，生态工业示范园区通过提升绿色技术多样性、创新要素配置效率以及外部媒体关注度来增强绿色创新集聚。这些成果丰富了关于生态工业示范园区与绿色创新集聚的研究，并为优化生态工业示范园区治理、改善绿色创新资源配置以及加速形成区域协调的绿色创新体系提供了政策启示。

title: Human capital consequences of expanding the supply of higher education institutions in a developing country
title_zh: 发展中国家扩大高等教育机构供给的人力资本后果

title: The effect of master’s level social worker licensing reform in Illinois
title_zh: 伊利诺伊州硕士级社会工作者执照改革的影响

abstract: Standard welfare evaluations of means-tested transfers typically treat eligibility enforcement as affecting only households directly exposed to the rule. We show that this direct-only approach is incomplete when enforcement events transmit information through workplace networks, inducing other beneficiaries to adjust formal employment and reported earnings. We study Uruguay's AFAM-PE conditional cash transfer, in which household income eligibility is verified monthly using administrative records of formal earnings and households exceeding the threshold may lose benefits, while most beneficiaries are largely unaware of the income rule. Linking program records, social security employment histories, and firm identifiers, we build workplace networks defined six months before each peer's exposure to enforcement and identify spillovers using a fuzzy regression discontinuity design that exploits quasi-random variation in whether a peer crosses the income threshold. Coworkers of peers just above the cutoff reduce registered labor earnings by 20%, and the corresponding fuzzy-RD estimate implies a decline of about one-third of baseline earnings in response to a peer's suspension. These effects emerge within two months and persist for at least 12 months. The response operates almost entirely on the extensive margin of formal employment, and most of the decline reflects transitions to informal work rather than exit from the labor force. Spillovers are concentrated in small firms and among similar coworkers, are nearly three times larger when the suspended peer actively contacted the program's support service, and are absent among non-beneficiary coworkers. This pattern is consistent with information transmission as the main channel. Incorporating these indirect responses lowers the estimated MVPF of the program as implemented with enforcement from 0.53 to 0.36. Because the same information channel operates wherever means-tested programs are enforced through records of formal earnings, evaluations that count only directly exposed households systematically understate the cost of enforcement.
abstract_zh: 对家计调查型转移支付的福利评估通常将资格核查视为仅影响直接受规则约束的家庭。我们证明，当核查事件通过工作场所网络传递信息，促使其他受益人调整正规就业和申报收入时，这种仅关注直接影响的评估方法是不完整的。本研究以乌拉圭AFAM-PE有条件现金转移项目为对象，该项目每月通过行政记录核实家庭收入资格，超出阈值的家庭可能失去福利，但多数受益人对收入规则知之甚少。通过关联项目记录、社保就业历史及企业标识，我们构建了每位同伴接受核查前六个月的工作场所网络，并利用同伴是否跨越收入阈值的准随机变化，采用模糊断点回归设计识别溢出效应。结果显示，略高于收入阈值的同伴的同事，其登记劳动收入下降20%；对应的模糊断点回归估计表明，同伴被暂停资格后，其同事基线收入下降约三分之一。这些影响在两个月内显现并持续至少12个月。反应几乎完全体现在正规就业的集约边际上，收入下降主要源于向非正规工作的转移而非退出劳动力市场。溢出效应集中于小型企业和相似同事群体中；当被暂停资格的同伴主动联系项目支持服务时，溢出效应扩大近三倍，而非受益同事中则无此现象。这一模式与信息传递作为主要渠道的假设一致。将间接反应纳入评估后，该项目在核查机制下的估计边际价值公共资金（MVPF）从0.53降至0.36。由于凡是通过正规收入记录执行家计调查的项目均存在相同的信息传递渠道，仅统计直接受影响家庭的评估方法会系统性低估核查成本。
title: Enforcement Spillovers and the Efficiency Costs of Means-Tested Transfers: Evidence from Workplace Networks
title_zh: 执法溢出效应与收入审查型转移支付的效率成本：基于职场网络的证据

abstract: Is the top of the economics profession becoming more insular? We study the placement of top PhD graduates over the past quarter-century, matching them to their advisors. Three trends point towards greater openness: graduates increasingly place outside academia, outside the US, and into a tech sector recruiting broadly across gender, ethnicity, and program prestige. The disaggregated picture is less reassuring: the Emerging South is largely sidelined in the global job market, East Asians face persistent gaps in top academic placement, and elite advisors continue to confer substantial advantages within academia. Tech placement, meanwhile, is dominated by a single employer.
abstract_zh: 经济学界顶尖群体是否正变得愈发封闭？我们研究了近25年来顶尖博士毕业生的就业去向，并将其与导师进行匹配。三项趋势表明开放性增强：毕业生越来越多地进入学术界以外、美国以外以及科技行业就业，且科技行业的招聘在性别、种族和院校声望方面具有广泛包容性。然而细分数据却令人担忧：新兴南方国家在全球就业市场中基本被边缘化，东亚裔在顶尖学术岗位中持续面临差距，精英导师在学术界仍能赋予显著优势。与此同时，科技行业的就业高度集中于单一雇主。
authors: Markus Eberhardt; Giovanni Facchini; Valeria Rueda
title: Expanding Opportunities: New Facts about the Placement of PhD Economists
title_zh: 拓展机遇：经济学博士就业分布的新事实

abstract: The EU’s fiscal governance framework was built to contribute to overall macroeconomic stability through compliance with fiscal rules and the commitment not to bail-out countries in trouble. Yet successive crises have revealed vulnerabilities under systemic stress: countries with a propensity to run deficits push frugal ones into ex-post bail-out arrangements to avert collapse, thus undermining the ex-ante credibility of the framework. The absence of a permanent, preventive instrument forces the Union to oscillate between leniency and emergency intervention. A permanent RRF-like mechanism - linking EU funds to reform and investment projects - offers an incentive compatible solution and a possible bridge to a larger EU budget.
abstract_zh: 欧盟的财政治理框架旨在通过遵守财政规则以及不救助陷入困境国家的承诺，促进整体宏观经济稳定。然而，接连不断的危机揭示了系统性压力下的脆弱性：倾向于赤字运行的国家迫使节俭国家在事后采取救助安排以避免崩溃，从而削弱了该框架的事前可信度。由于缺乏永久性的预防工具，欧盟不得不在宽松政策与紧急干预之间摇摆。一个类似复苏与韧性基金的永久性机制——将欧盟资金与改革和投资项目挂钩——提供了一种激励相容的解决方案，并可能成为迈向更大规模欧盟预算的桥梁。
title: Addressing the EU’s fiscal dilemma: From ex-post transfers to ex-ante resilience
title_zh: 应对欧盟财政困境：从事后转移支付转向事前韧性

abstract: Despite unprecedented access to information in the digital age, young citizens face growing challenges related to news consumption and misinformation. This large-scale randomized controlled trial examines the impact of two complementary interventions designed to foster media literacy and the consumption of high-quality news among high-school students, implemented in France over the 2024-25 academic year. The study involves 243 high schools (for a total number of 9,628 students), randomly assigned to a control group or to receive one or both of the following interventions: (i) a one-year free digital subscription to the leading national newspaper, and (ii) media education modules implemented by teachers. Exploiting unique data on students' actual online news consumption, we document a very large uptake of the free subscription, which translates into persistent and large increases in news consumption (+0.49 to 0.60 sd) and demand for future news, including an 8pp increase in paid subscriptions nearly a year after the intervention. We also observe a 0.20 to 0.31 sd increase in news knowledge for students enrolled in deprived schools, reducing baseline information inequality by 45-70%. Finally, we show that both free news access and media education improve media literacy skills (+0.08 to 0.26 sd), with larger effects among students taught by teachers with prior experience in media education.
abstract_zh: 尽管数字时代信息获取空前便捷，但年轻公民在新闻消费与应对虚假信息方面仍面临日益严峻的挑战。本项大规模随机对照试验考察了两项互补性干预措施的效果——旨在培养高中生媒介素养并促进高质量新闻消费，于2024-25学年在法国实施。研究涵盖243所高中（共计9,628名学生），随机分配至对照组或接受以下一项或两项干预：（i）为期一年的全国性主流报纸免费数字订阅；（ii）由教师实施的媒介教育模块。通过利用学生实际在线新闻消费的独特数据，我们发现免费订阅的采纳率极高，这转化为新闻消费的持续大幅增长（效应量0.49至0.60个标准差）及未来新闻需求的提升，包括干预实施近一年后付费订阅率增加8个百分点。在贫困学校就读的学生中，我们还观察到新闻知识水平提升0.20至0.31个标准差，使基线信息不平等程度降低45-70%。最后，研究表明免费新闻获取与媒介教育均能提升媒介素养技能（效应量0.08至0.26个标准差），且对由具备媒介教育经验的教师授课的学生影响更大。
authors: Simon Briole; Julia Cage; Andrea Prat
title: Making Teenagers Read Newspapers. A Nationwide Experiment in French High Schools
title_zh: 让青少年阅读报纸：法国高中的全国性实验

abstract: What role do firms play in geographic wage disparities? This paper exploits establishment mobility as a novel source of identification to separate firm sorting from location treatment effects, i.e., the local wage premium for a given worker at a given firm (due to, e.g., geography, infrastructure, amenities). Using data from France and the U.S., we first document key facts about establishment relocation: 4% of establishments move each year, retaining their activity and structure while adjusting their workforce and wages. Combining establishment and worker mobility in France, we estimate a model that decomposes wage variation due to workers, firms, and locations. Spatial wage differences are primarily driven by sorting: worker composition accounts for 30%, firm composition for 17%, and their co-location for 34%. Residual location effects explain only 2–4%. Establishment sorting also accounts for most of the urban wage premium and the higher wage growth in larger cities.
abstract_zh: 企业在地区工资差异中扮演何种角色？本文利用企业迁移作为新的识别来源，将企业分类效应与区位处理效应（即给定工人和给定企业在特定地点获得的工资溢价，例如由地理、基础设施、便利设施等因素导致）分离开来。基于法国和美国的数据，我们首先记录了企业迁移的关键事实：每年有4%的企业迁移，它们在保留自身活动和结构的同时调整员工队伍和工资水平。结合法国企业和工人的流动性，我们估计了一个分解工人、企业和地点对工资变化影响的模型。空间工资差异主要由分类效应驱动：工人构成解释30%，企业构成解释17%，两者共同定位解释34%。残余的区位效应仅解释2-4%。企业分类效应还解释了大部分城市工资溢价以及大城市中更高的工资增长。
authors: Pauline Carry; Benny Kleinman; Elio Nimier-David
china_relevance_reason: 研究使用法国和美国数据，不涉及中国
title: Location Effects or Sorting? Evidence from Firm Relocation
title_zh: 区位效应还是分类效应？来自企业搬迁的证据

abstract: The central trade-off for designing Disability Insurance (DI) is between providing insurance to those in need while maintaining incentives to work. This paper develops a novel revealed-preference approach to identify the insurance value of DI benefits. We show that comparing the DI take-up response to a change in benefits versus a change in wages identifies the insurance value. Implementing our framework in Canada, we estimate that increasing DI benefits by $1 creates an additional disincentive cost of $0.60 but creates an insurance value of $2.20. Thus, our approach suggests that DI benefits are not overly generous in the Canadian context.
abstract_zh: 设计残疾保险（DI）的核心权衡在于：既要为有需要者提供保障，又要维持工作激励。本文提出一种新颖的显示性偏好方法，用以识别DI福利的保险价值。研究表明，通过比较福利变化与工资变化对DI参保率的影响，即可识别其保险价值。在加拿大应用该框架后，我们估算出：每增加1美元DI福利，会产生0.60美元的额外抑制成本，但能创造2.20美元的保险价值。因此，我们的方法表明，在加拿大背景下，DI福利并未过度慷慨。
title: Measuring the Value of Disability Insurance from Take-Up Decisions
title_zh: 从参保决策衡量伤残保险的价值

abstract: Firms often rebrand to counter negative shocks, but can it work? Using a historical natural experiment, we analyze a large sample of companies from the same industry (banking) that shared very similar names, but overwhelmingly decided to change them in response to a common, negative news shock. U.S. entry into World War I in 1917 created a sudden anti-German backlash against anything that invoked an association with the now enemy. The shock itself was thus orthogonal to bank fundamentals and pre-existing trends, but pushed banks to reconsider their brands. After 1917, the few German-named banks that kept their tainted names saw significant declines in assets, deposits, and market share relative to other banks. However, German-named banks that rebranded mitigated much of the negative shock. Specifically, German-named banks that adopted a new non-ethnic brand name avoided between 75% and 85% of the anti-German effect, and those that adopted a new patriotic brand name were able to neutralize it completely. Overall, we find that "crisis rebranding" paid off in our historical setting regardless of the chosen brand, with patriotic rebranding proving the most effective at offsetting the exogenous shock.
abstract_zh: 企业常通过品牌重塑应对负面冲击，但这一策略是否有效？借助历史自然实验，我们分析了同一行业（银行业）中大量名称高度相似的公司样本，这些公司在面临共同负面新闻冲击时，绝大多数选择更改名称。1917年美国加入第一次世界大战，引发了对任何与敌国（德国）相关事物的突然反德情绪。这一冲击本身与银行基本面及既有趋势正交，却促使银行重新审视其品牌。1917年后，少数保留受污名化德文名称的银行，其资产、存款及市场份额相较于其他银行显著下滑。然而，进行品牌重塑的德文名称银行在很大程度上缓解了负面冲击。具体而言，采用非族裔新品牌名称的德文名称银行避免了75%至85%的反德效应，而采用爱国新品牌名称的银行则完全抵消了这一影响。总体而言，我们发现无论选择何种品牌，历史情境下的“危机品牌重塑”均取得了成效，其中爱国品牌重塑在抵消外生冲击方面最为有效。
authors: Kilian Rieder; Matthew Jaremski; Kris Mitchener
title: Banking on a Corporate Rebrand
title_zh: 押注企业品牌重塑

abstract: We investigate the short- and long-run impacts of unexpected mortality on psychosocial health in the context of a large-scale high-mortality natural disaster, the 2004 Indian Ocean earthquake and tsunami. The effects of the tsunami-related mortality measured at the community level are contrasted with the effects of individual-specific loss of close kin using population-representative longitudinal survey data from the Study of the Tsunami Aftermath and Recovery. In the short-run, two years post-tsunami, both community and individual-level mortality exposures are significant predictors of elevated depression and post-traumatic stress symtoms. In the longer-run, ten years post-tsunami, individual-level exposures are slightly attenuated but remain significant predictors of both psychosocial health measures; in contrast, community-level mortality predicts post-traumatic stress but not depression symptoms. Mortality is linked to smaller household sizes in the short- and long-run and to less social support in the long-run, although the latter effect differs substantially for males and females. The estimates adjust for other tsunami exposure measures and, in the individual-level analyses, we compare people living in the same community at the time of the tsunami who were exposed to the same community-level mortality rate.
abstract_zh: 本文以2004年印度洋地震海啸这一大规模高死亡率自然灾害为背景，探究意外死亡对心理社会健康的短期与长期影响。通过使用"海啸后果与恢复研究"中具有人口代表性的纵向调查数据，我们将社区层面测量的海啸相关死亡率影响与个体层面近亲丧失的影响进行对比。在短期（海啸后两年）内，社区与个体层面的死亡暴露均是抑郁症状与创伤后应激症状加剧的显著预测因子。在长期（海啸后十年）内，个体层面暴露的影响虽略有减弱，但仍对两项心理健康指标具有显著预测作用；相比之下，社区层面死亡率仅能预测创伤后应激症状，而非抑郁症状。死亡率与短期及长期家庭规模缩小相关，并与长期社会支持减少相关，但后者效应在男女性别间存在显著差异。本研究在估计中调整了其他海啸暴露指标，并在个体层面分析中，对比了海啸发生时居住于同一社区且面临相同社区死亡率的人群。
authors: Duncan Thomas; Elizabeth Frankenberg; Cecep Sumantri
title: Psychosocial Health and Well-Being After A Mortality Shock
title_zh: 死亡率冲击后的心理社会健康与福祉

abstract: ABSTRACT Since 2014, the number of schools offering universal free meals to all enrolled children without requiring annual meal applications has increased meaningfully. Using USDA's Purchase to Plate Crosswalk, a difference‐in‐differences framework, and a nationwide consumer panel, the effect of universal‐free‐meal exposure on the diet quality of food‐at‐home purchases is assessed in terms of the Healthy Eating Index (HEI). Consistent with earlier findings, households exposed to universal free meals reduce grocery spending by over 6%. There is no deleterious overall effect of universal‐free‐meal exposure on the diet quality of food‐at‐home purchases as measured by the HEI.
abstract_zh: 摘要 自2014年以来，无需年度餐食申请即可向所有在校儿童提供免费餐食的学校数量显著增加。本研究利用美国农业部的"从采购到餐盘"数据转换工具、双重差分框架以及全国消费者面板数据，以健康饮食指数（HEI）为衡量标准，评估了普及免费餐食政策对家庭食品购买中居家饮食质量的影响。与早期研究结果一致，受普及免费餐食政策影响的家庭，其食品杂货支出减少了6%以上。以HEI为衡量指标，普及免费餐食政策对居家食品购买的整体饮食质量并未产生不利影响。
title: Do Universal Free School Meals Improve the Dietary Quality of Food‐At‐Home Purchases?

abstract: This paper uses artificial intelligence-enhanced agent computing to determine how to allocate budgetary resources within a large set of heterogeneous government programs targeting human capital. The approach considers essential features of the budget allocation process: multidimensionality, interdependencies between policy issues, and the political economy of public officials' collective action. The analysis uses highly disaggregated Mexican data covering the 2016-2022 period across 49 federal government human capital programs. It focuses on how expenditure affects program coverage, defined as the share of the population with a public problem and that has access to various government benefits to mitigate those problems, in the short run. The paper answers three research questions. First, how sensitive is program coverage to changes in public expenditure? Second, what are the structural bottlenecks behind poor coverage response? Third, what are the optimal budgetary allocations that could boost the performance of a multidimensional objective function?
abstract_zh: 本文运用人工智能增强型智能体计算方法，探讨如何在针对人力资本的大量异质性政府项目中分配预算资源。该方法考虑了预算分配过程的核心特征：多维性、政策议题间的相互依存性，以及公共官员集体行动的政治经济学因素。分析采用2016-2022年期间墨西哥49个联邦政府人力资本项目的高度细化数据，重点研究支出如何影响项目覆盖率——即存在公共问题且能获得各类政府福利以缓解问题的人口比例——的短期效应。本文回答三个研究问题：第一，项目覆盖率对公共支出变化的敏感度如何？第二，导致覆盖率响应不足的结构性瓶颈是什么？第三，能够提升多维目标函数绩效的最优预算分配方案是什么？

abstract: Multidimensional poverty metrics offer a more complete picture of poverty than monetary poverty, yet their adoption has been limited by data constraints. Often not all dimensions in a multidimensional measure are observed in the same survey, leading to countries being excluded from global measures. This study introduces a novel data fusion approach to estimate multidimensional poverty metrics by combining summary statistics from multiple data sources. The proposed method is validated by simulating typical missing data scenarios using 571 household surveys from 112 countries (1989–2024) to estimate the World Bank’s Multidimensional Poverty Measure. The fusion method accurately predicts various multidimensional poverty metrics across these scenarios, even in the presence of simulated sample bias reflecting differences in survey design. It enables estimates of multidimensional poverty for a greater number of countries, gap-filling in time series, and the inclusion of previously unavailable indicators and dimensions in global multidimensional poverty measures.
abstract_zh: 多维贫困指标相比货币贫困能更全面地反映贫困状况，但其应用受限于数据约束。由于多维贫困指标中的各个维度往往无法在同一项调查中完整观测，导致许多国家被排除在全球性贫困测度之外。本研究提出一种创新的数据融合方法，通过整合多个数据源的汇总统计量来估算多维贫困指标。该方法利用112个国家（1989-2024年）的571项家庭调查数据，通过模拟典型数据缺失场景对世界银行多维贫困测度进行验证。结果表明，即便在存在反映调查设计差异的模拟样本偏差时，该融合方法仍能准确预测各类多维贫困指标。该方法不仅能够为更多国家提供多维贫困估算，填补时间序列数据缺口，还能将此前无法获取的指标和维度纳入全球多维贫困测度体系。
